chunks: If God were to give in abundance to His creatures they would fill the earth with oppression. So He gives according to measure as He will. He knows (what is good for) His creatures. He is all-aware and all-seeing.
ai.seo_question: Why does God limit sustenance to prevent corruption on earth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the balance between divine mercy and human nature; while abundance is a blessing, unrestricted wealth often leads to arrogance and moral decay (bagh). The limitation of rizq is thus viewed as a protective wisdom that prevents corruption, reflecting Allah's intimate knowledge (khabir) of human capacity and His all-seeing awareness (basir) of the consequences of His decrees.
